study: F2 WP2.1 - barycentric DSN light time for production counted Doppler (MEAS-01, X-07)
source_of_predeclaration: docs/assurance/vv-program.md F2 table (WP2.1 row, written 2026-10-31 before any WP2.1 code); this file formalises it for the first slice
scope_slice_1: two-way counted Doppler in the batch estimators (BLS-LM, SRIF) and observability, via RangeRatePhysicsConfig(counted_doppler_model='barycentric_dsn'); SR-UKF fails closed at the scenario loader
physics: relativistic_light_time.DSN_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL: SSB legs, Sun+Earth Shapiro (Moyer 8-38, gamma=1), TT interval
default_behaviour: unchanged; the new model is opt-in, so every frozen baseline stays bitwise

G1_one_way_light_time_vs_spice_cn.oracle: spkezr(..., 'CN', ...) light time, Moon centre -> Earth centre

G2_shapiro_vs_line_integral.oracle: scipy.quad of 2GM/(c^3 r) along the straight leg

G3_materiality.rule: |barycentric - Moon-centred| < 2e-4 m/s and max > 1e-6 m/s (Phase C1: -68...+87 um/s)

G5_bls_recovery.rule: noise-free BLS-LM from an 80 m / 0.02 m/s offset recovers position < 1 cm and velocity < 1e-5 m/s

G6_model_mismatch_evidence.rule: Moon-centred model at the truth misfits barycentric data with RMS > 1e-6 m/s

G7_fail_closed.rule: legacy station grid, hz output, clock drift, non-Doppler mode and UKF are rejected

amendments.reason: measured 4.0e-12 s. SPICE's own SSB states are evaluated at a rounded et, giving ~30 km/s x ulp(et) ~ 3.6 mm (1.2e-11 s) of epoch quantisation; direct differencing of spkezr positions over 0.65-2.6 s shows the same 0.7-1.5 mm scatter for MOON, EARTH and EMB. The module under test removes that quantisation, so 1e-12 s is below the oracle's floor

amendments.change: per-element rtol 1e-5 with 1 m / 1e-3 m/s steps -> row-norm tolerance with 10 m / 1e-2 m/s steps
amendments.reason: the FD estimate of the vz element moved as ~1/h (1e-4: 9.6e-6, 1e-3: 1.8e-6, 1e-2: 3.1e-7 absolute), i.e. re-propagation noise; the qualified Moon-centred Jacobian shows the same 1e-5 floor at these steps

reject_if: any gate fails as computed, or a frozen default-path baseline changes
